decisions.reason: The original Definition admits the unit seed ball for F(x,lambda)=x+x^3 and initial section lambda=0: x=0 is a regular global branch and the augmented residual has exactly one zero. At its center DG=I, so every sound beta is at least 1; the derivative diag(1+3x^2,1) requires L at least 6 on the unit ball (difference quotients as x approaches 1), hence q=beta*L*R is at least 6. Step 1 returns this seed immediately when N_req=0, contradicting the promised contraction record for every output ball. The repair preserves that output promise by requiring the initial seed to carry all hypotheses, bounds and inequalities of the existing contraction theorem, plus whole-ball tube/chart inclusion and initial angle data. No external theorem or new prerequisite is needed. The original confirmed-fatal outcome and type are preserved. Root separately corrected the ensuing scope reduction: The completed native repair excludes an originally valid unique-root seed by demanding a contraction certificate on that supplied ball. For G=(x+x^3,lambda) on the unit ball the unique root and regular chart are certified, but beta>=1 and L>=6 make q>=6. The guarded correction distinguishes seed evidence from newly appended contraction-certified balls and preserves the sound native initialization fix.

Confirmed a dependency-interface defect: both cited BE/RK definitions require the base pair in D, while the original wrapper required only defined field evaluations. With D=(0,2) x R, t_0=0, t_1=1, f=0 and Y_0=0 the residual G(z)=z is defined on R but the first cited call is inadmissible. Added (t_0,Y_0) in D and a test before later BE/RK calls; a finite-tolerance RK update need not remain in its next base-time slice. The original confirmed-fatal outcome and type are preserved. Root separately corrected the ensuing scope reduction: The completed native repair adds an unconditional initial-domain hypothesis even to externally supplied BDF2 histories whose procedure never evaluates the field at the initial time. The concrete original-valid histories on D=(1/2,5/2) x R and grid(0,1,2) establish the lost scope. The correction retains every genuine BE/RK per-call guard and adds an explicit BE-startup guard instead.
